items.text: captureVisualEvidence helper in common.steps.ts: screenshots every Playwright-mode scenario (pass or fail) to reports/screenshots/{featureSlug}/{scenarioSlug}--{human}.png
Before hook stores featureSlug/scenarioSlug on World; After hook reuses them; failure-mode writes sibling {scenarioSlug}--{human}.error.json (retires FAIL- screenshot naming)
E2EWorld gains featureSlug?/scenarioSlug? properties for hook-to-hook handoff
load-cucumber.ts ScenarioResult gains tags: string[] mapped from element.tags[].name
aggregate.ts computes summary.visualValidation 2x2 (validatedPassing/validatedRegressed/pendingPassing/pendingFailing) only in Playwright mode; profile allowlist detection
aggregate.ts emits visual-regression finding (tag + failed): source/severity:error/pillar/message/screenshotPath/suggestedObjective; scenario-failure findings gain screenshotPath
render-markdown.ts new ## Visual Validation section (2x2 table + bucket summary) + screenshot links in visual-regression/scenario-failure finding rows
sprint-report.schema.json: summary.visualValidation object (4 required ints, additionalProperties false) + visual-regression in Finding.source enum + optional Finding.screenshotPath
@elohim-visually-validated tag: manually authored in git, runtime no-op, stays until human removes; regression surfaces as finding (no auto-remove); pending-passing is review backlog
Tests in scripts/__tests__/: tags extraction, 2x2 bucket math, non-Playwright omission, visual-regression gating, screenshotPath population; + Playwright capture integration smoke
Deferred follow-ups: agent-assisted review /shift skill update (prompt template + manifesto excerpts per pillar + PR-proposal flow); reference-image storage / pixel-drift detection
